name.es: Concejo de la Villa de Key Biscayne

title.en: Select FSV Construction for the Beach Park renovation (first reading)
title.es: Seleccionar a FSV Construction para la renovación de Beach Park (primera lectura)
title.ht: Chwazi FSV Construction pou renovasyon Beach Park (premye lekti)

title.en: Ratify an emergency purchase of Community Center elevator repairs from Metro Elevator of South Florida
title.es: Ratificar una compra de emergencia de reparaciones del ascensor del Community Center a Metro Elevator of South Florida
title.ht: Ratifye yon acha ijans pou reparasyon asansè Community Center nan men Metro Elevator of South Florida

title.en: Park use fees and non-exclusive licenses for nonpublic schools to use the Village Green
title.es: Tarifas de uso de parques y licencias no exclusivas para que escuelas no públicas usen el Village Green
title.ht: Frè itilizasyon pak ak lisans ki pa eksklizif pou lekòl ki pa piblik itilize Village Green

title.en: Select Advanced Roofing for the Community Center roof coating system
title.es: Seleccionar a Advanced Roofing para el sistema de recubrimiento del techo del Community Center
title.ht: Chwazi Advanced Roofing pou sistèm kouch pwoteksyon do kay Community Center

title.en: Change orders for the Building, Zoning and Planning office renovation (first reading)
title.es: Órdenes de cambio para la renovación de la oficina de Building, Zoning and Planning (primera lectura)
title.ht: Lòd chanjman pou renovasyon biwo Building, Zoning and Planning (premye lekti)

title.en: Site plan for two commercial buildings with retail/office space and a padel court facility at 12-22-24 Crandon Boulevard
title.es: Plan del sitio para dos edificios comerciales con espacio de tiendas/oficinas y una instalación de canchas de pádel en 12-22-24 Crandon Boulevard
title.ht: Plan sit pou de bilding komèsyal ak espas magazen/biwo ak yon enstalasyon teren padel nan 12-22-24 Crandon Boulevard

title.en: Select Advanced Roofing for Community Center roof repairs using a Broward College contract
title.es: Seleccionar a Advanced Roofing para reparaciones del techo del Community Center usando un contrato de Broward College
title.ht: Chwazi Advanced Roofing pou reparasyon do kay Community Center itilize yon kontra Broward College

title.en: Select Millennium Builders for the Building, Zoning and Planning office renovation
title.es: Seleccionar a Millennium Builders para la renovación de la oficina de Building, Zoning and Planning
title.ht: Chwazi Millennium Builders pou renovasyon biwo Building, Zoning and Planning

title.en: Select The Stout Group and Metro Express for milling and paving under ITB 2025-10
title.es: Seleccionar a The Stout Group y Metro Express para fresado y pavimentación bajo el ITB 2025-10
title.ht: Chwazi The Stout Group ak Metro Express pou grataj ak pavaj dapre ITB 2025-10

title.en: Settlement with Sully Holdings II and the Key Biscayne Social Club over 19-21 Harbor Drive
title.es: Acuerdo de conciliación con Sully Holdings II y el Key Biscayne Social Club sobre 19-21 Harbor Drive
title.ht: Akò règleman ak Sully Holdings II ak Key Biscayne Social Club sou 19-21 Harbor Drive

title.en: Second amendment to the AECOM professional services agreement
title.es: Segunda enmienda al acuerdo de servicios profesionales con AECOM
title.ht: Dezyèm amannman akò sèvis pwofesyonèl ak AECOM

title.en: Buy two fire vehicles from Garber Chevrolet, waiving competitive bidding
title.es: Comprar dos vehículos de bomberos a Garber Chevrolet, con exención de licitación competitiva
title.ht: Achte de machin ponpye nan men Garber Chevrolet, ak egzanpsyon apèl dòf konpetitif

title.en: Agreement with the Key Biscayne Community Foundation to set up a fiscal sponsorship fund
title.es: Acuerdo con la Key Biscayne Community Foundation para crear un fondo de patrocinio fiscal
title.ht: Akò ak Key Biscayne Community Foundation pou mete sou pye yon fon parennaj fiskal

title.en: Buy cardiac monitors and related equipment from Stryker Sales
title.es: Comprar monitores cardíacos y equipos relacionados a Stryker Sales
title.ht: Achte monitè kadyak ak ekipman ki mache avè yo nan men Stryker Sales

title.en: Variance to measure building height from base flood elevation plus 3 ft at 520 South Mashta Drive
title.es: Variación para medir la altura del edificio desde la elevación de inundación base más 3 pies en 520 South Mashta Drive
title.ht: Varyans pou mezire wotè bilding nan apati elevasyon inondasyon debaz plis 3 pye nan 520 South Mashta Drive

title.en: Variance for an 11 ft rear zone elevation at 520 South Mashta Drive
title.es: Variación para una elevación de 11 pies en la zona trasera en 520 South Mashta Drive
title.ht: Varyans pou yon elevasyon 11 pye nan zòn dèyè a nan 520 South Mashta Drive

title.en: Select CSR Heavy Construction for design-build of artificial turf at St. Agnes athletic field (second reading)
title.es: Seleccionar a CSR Heavy Construction para el diseño y construcción de césped artificial en el campo deportivo de St. Agnes (segunda lectura)
title.ht: Chwazi CSR Heavy Construction pou konsepsyon ak konstriksyon gazon atifisyèl sou teren espò St. Agnes (dezyèm lekti)

title.en: Accept a drainage easement from VDM 2014 Irrevocable Trust at 490 West Matheson Drive and 1 Harbor Point
title.es: Aceptar una servidumbre de drenaje de VDM 2014 Irrevocable Trust en 490 West Matheson Drive y 1 Harbor Point
title.ht: Aksepte yon sèvitid drenaj nan men VDM 2014 Irrevocable Trust nan 490 West Matheson Drive ak 1 Harbor Point

title.en: Side setback variance (3 ft 3 in) for 920 Mariner Drive
title.es: Variación de retiro lateral (3 pies 3 pulgadas) para 920 Mariner Drive
title.ht: Varyans distans sou kote (3 pye 3 pous) pou 920 Mariner Drive

next.name: Key Biscayne Village Council

schedule.note: Council meeting with second-reading ordinance; FY2027 budget was adopted by Sept 30 per village news
Council meeting, second reading of three ordinances

next.pattern: Roughly monthly on a Tuesday at 6:30 p.m., Council Chamber, 560 Crandon Boulevard (rear of the fire station). The village does not publish a fixed day-of-month rule online; 2026 posted meeting dates were Jan 13, Mar 10, May 14, Jun 9, Aug 25, Sep 22 and Oct 13, taken from second-reading notices.

levers.how: Fill out a Public Comment Form and hand it to the Village Clerk before the item is heard, then speak when called during the public comment portion.
levers.rules: Register with the Clerk before the item is heard. No time limit is stated on the agendas page or in the meeting notice; the Public Comment Card PDF is an image and could not be read.
levers.deadline: Before the item is heard at the meeting

levers.rules: No word limit or cutoff stated in the notice.

levers.how: Each council member has a posted email (first initial plus last name at keybiscayne.fl.gov) and phone on the council page; the council office line is (305) 365-5506.
